name: auth-flow-otp-verify
title: Auth Flow OTP Verify
description: A one-time code screen built on a single native input under a segmented rail: digits drop into their slots, a glowing bar glides to the next one and the code checks itself when complete. A delivery switch for text, email or call, a depleting resend ring, attempt limits and a verifying sweep complete the flow.
author: Hyperblur <hello@hyperblur.dev>
